summary.text: Mathew McIntyre is a Republican member of the Maine House of Representatives for District 18 and is a candidate for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
McIntyre has represented District 18 since 2024 and is a U.S. Navy veteran.

paragraphs.text: Mathew McIntyre served in the U.S. Navy and earned a bachelor's degree from Excelsior University in 1998; as of 2024 he was retired, according to Ballotpedia.
McIntyre won District 18 in 2024, succeeding Meldon Carmichael, and is ranking member of the House Engrossed Bills Committee for 2025-2026.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he said he seeks to modernize the state's energy production and distribution systems, work to restore trust in elected officials, and create career pathways for younger Mainers.
He listed energy, utilities and infrastructure, public safety and security, and education as policy areas he is passionate about.
Democrat Jonathan C. Goble is his 2026 general election opponent.
